subject: Reseller evidence mapping and MSA cleanup for CloudCart marketplace listing
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Matsumoto <kyle@cloudcart.com>, partners-legal@cloudcart.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Reseller evidence mapping and next steps (MSA / order form)

Hi Kyle / CloudCart legal team,

Thanks again for walking through the marketplace onboarding last week. We got the draft partner paper back from your side and have compiled a short evidence matrix showing what CloudCart needs from Redwood to complete the pass-through and audit clauses on your reseller addendum. Attaching the working files: reseller-addendum_draft_v3.docx (redlines embedded) and evidence-matrix-cloudcart.xlsx.

Two quick asks to keep the process moving:
- Can your legal team confirm whether CloudCart requires Redwood to provide consolidated monthly invoices or per-tenant invoices for pass-through purposes? The evidence matrix includes both flows with examples; we can support either but need to align on accounting.
- For the audit-trigger language (Section 7.3 in your draft), please confirm the scope CloudCart expects (logs only vs. full access to billing records). Redwood prefers log-level evidence + signed attestation to avoid live tenant access.

Ben and Laura are cc'd for operational and procurement alignment. Our internal deadline is EOD 2/16 to get the MSA/order form settled so marketplace launch can remain on the 3/1 cadence. If helpful, Ben can set up a short triage call tomorrow.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com
Attachment: reseller-addendum_draft_v3.docx (docx)
Attachment: evidence-matrix-cloudcart.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Kyle Matsumoto <kyle@cloudcart.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: partners-legal@cloudcart.com, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@resellerco.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 11:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Reseller evidence mapping and next steps (MSA / order form)

Naomi — thanks for the clear matrix. A couple points from our side after a quick run with legal and finance:

1) Invoicing: Finance strongly prefers consolidated monthly invoices per reseller account (CloudCart will perform pass-through to end customers). Per-tenant invoices are workable but will require reconciliation overhead on our side. If Redwood can produce a consolidated invoice plus a CSV export with line-level mapping, that would be ideal.

2) Audit scope: Our legal team flagged that some enterprise customers want broader audit rights; however, for marketplace listing, CloudCart requires a path to evidence (billing records + redacted logs) not tenant-level access. The suggested attestation approach sounds acceptable — do you have a sample attestation text your compliance team typically uses?

3) Liability carveouts: partners-legal has redlined a small carveout around pass-through tax responsibilities. I forwarded the redline PDF to partners-legal (cc'd). Can Redwood confirm whether the carveout is acceptable or propose alternate wording?

We can do a short call today at 2pm PT if that helps. Alex Rivera from ResellerCo is looping in since they will be the first seller live on the CloudCart marketplace and want the pass-through flow validated.

Best,
Kyle
Kyle Matsumoto
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | CloudCart Inc.
kyle@cloudcart.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Matsumoto <kyle@cloudcart.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: partners-legal@cloudcart.com, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 13:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Reseller evidence mapping and next steps (MSA / order form)

Kyle/CloudCart legal — quick ops note from our side following Naomi's matrix:

- Invoice format: Redwood can emit a consolidated monthly invoice for a reseller account. We will include an optional CSV export that maps line items back to our internal order ids and customer identifiers. I'll attach a sample CSV layout after this thread.
- Attestation: Redwood's standard compliance attestation reads as follows (draft):
  "Redwood Inference certifies, to the best of its knowledge, that the billing records and aggregated access logs provided in response to a valid audit request accurately reflect the usage billed to CloudCart for the period specified, subject to redaction for PII or other customer-protected fields."

- Liability carveout: our legal team suggests replacing 'pass-through tax responsibility' language with: "CloudCart shall be responsible for collecting and remitting taxes on re-sold services where applicable; Redwood will provide reasonable documentation and cooperation for tax audits but does not assume tax collection obligations on behalf of CloudCart." That change keeps intent but reduces operational exposure to Redwood.

Laura — can you confirm whether the change above is acceptable for procurement and whether we need an alternate escrow/invoice flow?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Partner Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: sample-invoice-layout.csv (csv)

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Matsumoto <kyle@cloudcart.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: partners-legal@cloudcart.com
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Reseller evidence mapping and next steps (MSA / order form)

Kyle — appreciate the quick review. From procurement/finance standpoint the proposed Redwood language on tax allocation is acceptable; we just need one small addition to the MSA: an explicit mapping table reference in the order form that points to the CSV schema (so CloudCart procurement and their auditors can clearly reconcile). Ben's sample-invoice-layout.csv works; I'll add a short clause to the order form that references the Drive link with the schema.

Regarding the attestation: legal can accept the draft wording Ben provided as long as CloudCart acknowledges that attestations are limited to the data types called out in the evidence matrix (billing records, aggregated access logs). I've attached a PDF with inline annotations (signed-msa-redlines_annotated.pdf).

Next steps:
- Kyle/legal to confirm they accept the adjusted tax allocation sentence and the attestation limitation.
- Naomi to send an updated reseller addendum with the revised clause and an order form appendix that references the CSV schema link.
- If all good, Laura/Ben can approve and I will route to finance for final mailbox approval.

If you want a quick call to finalize language, 4pm PT today works for us; otherwise we'll plan to finalize in writing by EOD 2/17.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
Attachment: signed-msa-redlines_annotated.pdf (pdf)
